bullets.text: Humanoid Robot Bubble Warning - **China** warns of a potential bubble in the humanoid robotics industry amid rising **AI** investments.
Cyberattack Disrupts London Councils - Multiple **London** councils face major disruptions due to an ongoing cyberattack, activating emergency protocols.
AirTag Enhancements for Travelers - **Apple** improves AirTag features to help airlines recover lost luggage more efficiently.
Smart Playlists in Pocket Casts - The **Pocket Casts** app introduces smart playlists to enhance podcast organization and listening.
Anduril's Autonomous Weapons Issues - **Anduril Industries** faces setbacks in testing its autonomous weapons systems, raising safety concerns.
Nvidia Under Fire from Investor - **Michael Burry** targets **Nvidia**, questioning the sustainability of its AI-driven stock surge.
Dreame's Robovac Deal - The **Dreame X40 Ultra** offers a hands-free cleaning experience, now available at a significant discount.
Philips Hue Lights Discount - **Philips Hue** Festavia string lights are now heavily discounted, perfect for festive decorations.
Microsoft's AI Developer Insights - **Microsoft** reveals that up to 30% of code in some projects is now written by AI.
Glīd Wins Startup Battlefield - **Glīd** triumphs at Startup Battlefield 2025, aiming to simplify logistics with innovative solutions.
